name: Stripe
description: Two-way Stripe sync: import Stripe invoices as fully structured documents, push InvoiceLeaf invoices to Stripe for payment collection, and record Stripe payments. Payments matched to synced invoices mark them as paid automatically.

apiKey.instructions: Create a restricted API key in your Stripe dashboard (Developers > API keys) with read access to Invoices, Charges, and Customers, then paste it here.

triggers.name: Import Stripe Invoices
triggers.description: Imports finalized Stripe invoices into InvoiceLeaf as documents

triggers.name: Push Invoices to Stripe
triggers.description: Creates Stripe invoices from unpaid InvoiceLeaf receivable invoices so customers can pay them via Stripe

triggers.name: Sync Stripe Payments
triggers.description: Records succeeded Stripe charges as payments and allocates them to synced invoices, marking them paid

actions.name: Test Stripe Connection
actions.description: Verify the API key can read invoices and charges

initialSyncLookbackHours.title: Initial Sync Lookback (hours)
initialSyncLookbackHours.description: Used only until the first successful run checkpoint is stored.

importDraftInvoices.title: Import Draft Invoices
importDraftInvoices.description: When disabled, only finalized invoices (open, paid, uncollectible) are imported.

recordUnmatchedCharges.title: Record Unmatched Charges
recordUnmatchedCharges.description: When enabled, succeeded charges that cannot be matched to an imported invoice are still recorded as unmatched payments for manual reconciliation.

attachProviderPdf.title: Attach Stripe PDF
attachProviderPdf.description: Store the Stripe invoice PDF as the document file on import (the document data itself comes from the Stripe API, not from the PDF).

daysUntilDue.title: Days Until Due
daysUntilDue.description: Payment terms for pushed Stripe invoices when the document has no due date.

autoFinalizeInvoices.title: Auto-Finalize Pushed Invoices
autoFinalizeInvoices.description: Finalize pushed invoices so they are immediately payable. When disabled they stay as Stripe drafts.

configGroups.title: Invoice Push
configGroups.description: How InvoiceLeaf invoices are pushed to Stripe
